title: Same fit, two generations
speaker: the older man on the right with short silver hair and a grey beard
listener: the younger man on the left
voice: a deep, calm, warm, confident older man's voice, unhurried

shots.line: Remember, charcoal with white looks safe.
But add the waistcoat, and it looks powerful.
A cream knit with denim looks clean.
But add rust, and it looks rich.
And ivory with black? That looks expensive.
